decisions.rationale: The median-of-three implementation clamps correctly for ordered bounds; both public attestations also pass.
The candidate replaces case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive default sorting; both public attestations fail.
The strict less-than comparison excludes values equal to the limit, directly violating the specification; both public attestations fail.
The changed test asserts false for an input the specification requires to return true, so the joint claim cannot hold; both public attestations fail.

strategy_update: Follow unanimous public attestations and confirm each with one cheap exact-diff inspection while avoiding test execution.
